item.description:
Build 17 makes working with several ranges simpler.
- Ranges are numbered by where they sit in the video. Add one between 1 and 2 and it becomes 2; the rest move up. - Ranges can no longer overlap. Dragging or trimming a range stops at its neighbour, and older projects with overlapping ranges are trimmed apart when you open them. - Add a range by moving the playhead and pressing + Range (⌘⇧R). Dragging on the strip now only moves the playhead, and the yellow edges only make a range longer or shorter. - A trash button deletes the selected range. Press ⌘Z to bring it back. - One video per project: adding another video and manual reordering are gone.
Installed builds update to this one automatically (Settings → About → Automatically check for updates).
